title: APNs: background push vs alert push contradiction
description: The request format shows content-available:1 with no alert key (background push), but the urgency table maps high/normal urgency to apns-push-type:alert with apns-priority:10. Apple requires apns-push-type:alert to have an alert body in aps. Also, apns-collapse-id only works with alert pushes, so the collapse rationale breaks if using background pushes. The guide must commit to one model: either background-only (all use apns-push-type:background, apns-priority:5) or alert pushes (which require an alert body and change the design).
close_reason: Over-specified: guide should present both push modes as valid options with tradeoffs, not mandate background-only. Implementer decides based on app architecture.
